_README: Copy this object into records.json (not this file). Write every field yourselves from cited sources. Never invent an artisan, permission, licence or source. If you cannot cite it, drop the record.
workType: ritual | craft | textile | visual | performing | other
culturalContext: Written by you, in your own words (>= 2 sentences).
contextSources: Full citation or URL of source 1
sourceUrl: URL of the page the image/record comes from
licence: CC0 | PDM | CC-BY-4.0 | CC-BY-SA-4.0 | CC-BY-NC-4.0 | ARR
licenceSourceNote: Where the image and its licence come from (Commons file page URL, photographer, date checked).
custodian: Named custodian to contact, only if real and stated in a source
